exposure: fetal middle cerebral artery (MCA) pulsatility index (PI)
cohort: The study included 67 fetuses diagnosed with congenital heart defects (hypoplastic left heart syndrome, non-HLHS single ventricle, or dextrotransposition of the great arteries) and 42 normal control fetuses.
finding: The study found no significant associations between combined cardiac output or middle cerebral and umbilical artery pulsatility indices and late gestational weight gain or birth biometry in fetuses with congenital heart defects.
cross-section timing: Data collected at 30 weeks gestation and at birth.
birth_weight: Measured as an outcome; no specific inclusion range mentioned.
gest_age: Measurements taken at 30 weeks gestation and at birth.
